name: University of Bath
summary: A campus university in Bath, south-west England, with over 190 degrees, many with an optional paid placement year; IB offers are often 35–36 points.

ib.text: Offers give a total and three HL grades, e.g. 35 with 6,5,5 (Modern Languages) or 36 with 7,6,6 incl. HL Maths 6 (Accounting and Finance). With four HLs, your best three count.

dates.label: UCAS equal consideration deadline, 18:00 UK time

notes: Overseas fees for 2027 entry are £26,150 (humanities and social sciences), £29,500 (economics and management) or £32,950 (science and engineering) a year.
An EU national starting in 2027 may be Home or Overseas for fees depending on circumstances; without UK settled or pre-settled status, expect Overseas.
Placement years are usually paid, but Bath does not guarantee you a placement; its Placements Team helps you apply.
